cohort: 94 mothers who died during or shortly after pregnancy in the Khorasan Razavi Province, Iran, between 2010 and 2014
finding: The maternal mortality ratio was 17.68 (95%CI: 13.59-21.77) per 100,000 live births, with the most common causes of death being maternal hemorrhage (24.5%) and cardiovascular diseases (12.8%).
mod_finding: The relative risk of maternal mortality associated with cesarean section was 1.3 in comparison to normal vaginal delivery.
